# @ic-reactor/core

> ic-reactor 4 is in development on the v4 branch; the guide lands with DX3.

Applies to `@ic-reactor/core` 4.0.0-alpha.0.

This version is not released, and this file describes no API yet. For the
released 3.x packages, read the `llms.txt` shipped in their npm tarballs and
https://ic-reactor.b3pay.net/llms-full.txt.
